policy.naming: Use role names, not opaque numeric identifiers.
policy.model_selection: Select model and reasoning effort by task difficulty, ambiguity, integration risk, and validation responsibility. Do not use a binary model policy.
policy.worker_context: Workers are stateless and receive only scoped task packets, direct dependencies, required interfaces, and local invariants.
policy.convergence: After three failed convergence attempts on the same scope, escalate instead of looping.

agents.name: Architect
agents.role: Maintains V4.3 methodology compliance and cross-domain architecture.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Ambiguous architecture, graph authority decisions, cross-domain tradeoffs.

agents.name: Cartographer
agents.role: Extracts and normalizes concept, UI, and canonical graph structures.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Graph extraction, normalization, source traceability, ambiguity reports.

agents.name: Interface Steward
agents.role: Owns API contracts, interface payloads, integration mappings, and contract stability.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Public interfaces, mappings, examples, API and runtime contract validation.

agents.name: Data Steward
agents.role: Owns Supabase/Postgres persistence, RLS policy design, migration ordering, and data lineage.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Persistence, RLS, immutable graph/event tables, Supabase migration review.

agents.name: UI Steward
agents.role: Owns UI graph compliance, screen hierarchy, progressive disclosure, and visual design constraints.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Screen flows, UI implementation, design-system adherence, visual QA.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Generates executable task DAGs, graph slices, dependency order, and worker packets.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Task graph construction, dependency resolution, execution boundary slicing.

agents.name: Service Steward
agents.role: Owns GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, and secrets preflight without committing credentials.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Provider wiring, CLI checks, environment policy, deployment adapter setup.

agents.name: Builder
agents.role: Implements scoped product slices from validated task packets.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Bounded code implementation with explicit interfaces and acceptance checks.

agents.name: Mechanic
agents.role: Performs bounded mechanical transformations and simple verification tasks.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Deterministic formatting-free checks, schema sweeps, simple file inventories.

agents.name: Gatekeeper
agents.role: Runs structural, semantic, invariant, UI, and integration validation gates.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Blocking validation, cross-checks, failure classification, acceptance review.

agents.name: Integrator
agents.role: Checks cross-scope integration, runtime fit, API/data/UI consistency, and regression risk.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Combining completed worker outputs and validating subsystem boundaries.

agents.name: Reconciler
agents.role: Produces semantic diffs, lineage updates, retry routing, and escalation decisions.

recommended_model_policy.use_when: Graph reconciliation, mutation routing, non-convergence triage.
